items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: there’s really been only one musician and that’s Gerry Mulligan, who’s been able to really make it as a leader.

ctx.x: I know you have to get to another gig soon. Any immediate future plans or long term goals for you?

I just want to keep practicing and getting deeper inside this music. It’s funny you know, I’m 54 years old and I feel very committed to getting out there more as a leader. I’ve, up until this point, been a sideman in many different bands. And I really want to get out and start playing quartet and trio and getting out and getting more gigs under my own name so I can emerge as a leader on this instrument. Because there aren’t that many people who are dedicated to just playing the baritone saxophone. And I think in…
And a big part of that was his writing, right?
